Pitch Pipe Tool

A chromatic pitch pipe — tap any note from C to B across two octaves to hear a pure reference tone for tuning and singing.

📖 How to use

  1. Tap any note button to hear its pitch.
  2. Use the octave shift for higher or lower ranges.
  3. Match the tone by ear to tune or warm up.
  4. Tap Stop to silence a sustaining note.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which notes are included?

Two full octaves, C4 to B5, at A=440Hz concert pitch.

What does the tone sound like?

A pure sine wave — the cleanest reference for matching pitch by ear.

How do I play a note?

Tap a note to play it; tap again (or Stop) to silence it. Hold mode sustains while pressed.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes — works on desktop and mobile browsers.
